scope: Roaming mechanisms, measurement evidence, tool limits, and future validation. Focused review; not an exhaustive systematic review.
counting_rule: One record per distinct source or research work. A preprint and its later journal version are counted together. Technical documents are not counted as papers.

sources.title: Wi-Fi roaming support in Apple devices
sources.date_note: No publication date independently verified; live documentation retrieved on review_date.
sources.read_depth: Selected full-page sections: client ownership, candidate scoring, support matrix, 802.11r and 802.11v.
sources.summary: Documents client-owned roaming and assistance mechanisms. Candidate scoring already includes load-related information. Supports stronger baselines than signal alone.
limitations: Vendor-specific behavior
Support depends on device and operating-system version
Not a normative IEEE standard or independent experiment

sources.title: hostapd example configuration
authors: hostapd contributors; source hosted by Android Open Source Project
sources.read_depth: Selected configuration sections: BSS Load update, channel-utilization averaging, test values, and FT mobility domain.
sources.summary: Separately configurable load publication and averaging periods motivate explicit observation age. Fixed test values must be distinguished from measured load.
limitations: A pinned source snapshot, not proof of behavior in an installed device
Driver support must be verified

sources.title: ns-3 Wi-Fi Design Documentation
sources.version: Moving documentation retrieved 2026-10-14; inspected page numbered 35.1; release not pinned
sources.read_depth: Overview, scope and limitations, infrastructure association, and Layer-2 roaming sections inspected.
sources.summary: The inspected model documentation lists missing Layer-2 roaming, authentication/encryption, and processing delays. It cannot validate a complete transition without additional work.
limitations: Assertion applies to the inspected documentation, not every release or external extension
No ns-3 experiment was run

sources.title: Mininet-WiFi: Architecture and Components; Wireless Medium Emulation
sources.version: Live project documentation retrieved 2026-10-14; no release pin displayed
sources.read_depth: Introduction, architecture, Linux components, tc, and wmediumd sections inspected.
sources.summary: Linux tools and virtual Wi-Fi interfaces provide useful control-path emulation. The medium remains modeled, so results do not measure physical adapter behavior.
limitations: No emulator was run in this review
Radio and host scheduling assumptions need separate validation

sources.title: An Empirical Analysis of the IEEE 802.11 MAC Layer Handoff Process
sources.source_type: Institutional technical report; later journal article
sources.date_note: Date of the institutional report read. Related 2003 ACM SIGCOMM Computer Communication Review article, 33(2), 93-102, has DOI 10.1145/956981.956990; publisher page could not be opened in this review.
sources.read_depth: Institutional eight-page PDF accessed; targeted process, experimental, and latency-decomposition passages inspected. Extraction has damaged words; not a full reading of the later publisher version.
sources.summary: Early measurements separate scanning/probing, authentication, and reassociation, with strong equipment dependence. Useful measurement structure; not modern delay calibration.
limitations: Old hardware and protocols
Do not transfer timing values to current devices
Report and journal version are not two independent studies

sources.title: Unlocking Mobility for Wi-Fi-Based Wireless Time-Sensitive Networks
sources.date_note: Accepted 2024-02-20; current-version date shown in paper is 2024-03-01.
sources.read_depth: Institutional full PDF accessed; abstract and targeted passages on handover process, openwifi hardware implementation, delay measurement, and moment selection inspected.
sources.summary: Controlled openwifi experiments combine location and signal information with radio/driver changes. Supports phase-aware measurement, but does not calibrate commodity FT handoffs.
sources.evidence_kind: Physical experiments on a customized wireless TSN platform
limitations: Specialized hardware and software control
Location assistance
Not a stock campus client benchmark

sources.title: QUIC-HOA: A Cross-layer, Handover-aware Design for QUIC Connection Migration
sources.read_depth: Publisher and authors' institutional abstract/metadata only. Full text not obtained.
sources.summary: Studies handover-aware QUIC migration. Useful for separating transport recovery from AP selection; same-subnet simulation does not test the proposed transport mechanism.
sources.evidence_kind: Experiments reported by the abstract; methods not independently inspected
limitations: Abstract-only assessment
Numerical headline gains not reused
IP-changing hard handover differs from first project scope

sources.title: Wi-Fi Multi-Link Operation: An Experimental Study of Latency and Throughput
sources.source_type: Author preprint linked to a peer-reviewed journal article
sources.date_note: Author preprint is 2023; UPF institutional publication records place the journal issue in 2024. Do not count these as distinct research works.
sources.read_depth: Full preprint accessed; abstract, measurement dataset, trace-based simulation method, and selected result passages inspected.
sources.summary: Measured occupancy traces feed a multi-link simulator. Uneven link loads matter. This is not a direct physical Wi-Fi 7 roaming trial.
sources.evidence_kind: Measured channel-occupancy data and trace-driven simulation
limitations: Multi-link packet access differs from single-link AP handoff
Not contemporary commodity-client roaming measurements

sources.title: Seamless Roaming based on Distributed Multi-Link Operation over IEEE 802.11bn
sources.venue: 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Factory Communication Systems (WFCS)
sources.read_depth: Publisher abstract and conference metadata; full text not obtained. Author list cross-checked with DBLP; technical claims come from publisher abstract.
sources.summary: Proposes multi-AP connectivity and reports simulation evidence. Relevant future direction, not evidence of measured submillisecond commercial roaming.
sources.evidence_kind: Simulation, as stated by publisher abstract
limitations: Abstract-only review
Enhanced distributed MLO is outside first single-link scope
Does not establish product support

sources.title: wpa_supplicant control interface
sources.version: Documentation labeled 2.5; not a claim about current release
sources.read_depth: Commands, event notifications, STATUS, SCAN, BSS, and reassociation-related interface sections inspected.
sources.summary: Documents a control-and-event interface useful for a Linux test client. Command success and useful data recovery require separate observation.
limitations: Old documented version
Installed build and driver capabilities must be checked

sources.title: QUIC: A UDP-Based Multiplexed and Secure Transport
sources.read_depth: Sections 8.2 and 9 on validation and migration; not the full RFC.
sources.summary: Address migration and path validation operate above Wi-Fi association. Keeping one IP subnet avoids testing this separate mechanism in the first experiment.
limitations: Protocol behavior specification, not an empirical delay guarantee

sources.title: Identifiers for WebRTC's Statistics API
authors: W3C Web Real-Time Communications Working Group
sources.read_depth: Document status and selected inbound media statistics including freezeCount, totalFreezesDuration, concealedSamples, and concealmentEvents.
sources.summary: Defines media-level indicators for later experiments. Such indicators and synthetic deadlines are not direct measurements of human satisfaction.
limitations: Draft status
Browser field support must be checked
No human QoE model supplied by this source
